categories.main_business_segments: The company is a comprehensive solution provider for backlight display modules (BLU), which are critical components of LCD panels. Main business segments include: (1) Backlight display modules for various applications including notebooks, tablets, desktop monitors, automotive displays, medical displays, and industrial control displays; (2) Backlight display module components including light guide plates, precision structural parts, and optical materials; (3) Mini-LED related products and services including Mini-LED lamp boards, driver circuit design, and Micro-LED direct display solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses comprehensive technical capabilities in optical design, light guide plate design, precision mold design, and integrated structural design. Core manufacturing methods include: (1) Automated and intelligent manufacturing for notebook and tablet backlight modules with high yield rates; (2) Precision injection molding and stamping for structural components; (3) Optical film processing and precision manufacturing; (4) Mini-LED lamp board design with local dimming technology and circuit design capabilities; (5) Micro-LED direct display design and packaging processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major LCD panel manufacturers such as BOE (Beijing Oriental Electronics), TCL China Star Optoelectronics, Innolux, Tianma, and HKC. End-market applications span consumer electronics (notebooks, tablets, desktop monitors, smartphones) and automotive displays (instrument clusters, center consoles, secondary displays). The company also serves Tier-1 automotive suppliers and OEMs including NIO, Neta, FAW, Geely, Ford, and others. Products are widely used in VR devices, medical displays, and industrial control displays.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with manufacturing facilities in Hefei, Chongqing, Chuzhou, Guangzhou, and Qingdao. The company has established production lines for notebook (NB) products and is expanding Mini-LED product lines in Qingdao and planning expansion in Suzhou. Domestic sales account for 99.99% of revenue, with minimal international sales. The company maintains headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the display supply chain, positioned between upstream LED chip and material suppliers and downstream LCD panel manufacturers and consumer electronics brands. The company sources raw materials (LED chips, optical films, structural materials) from suppliers and manufactures integrated backlight modules and components that are sold to panel manufacturers and system integrators who incorporate them into final display products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Expanding automotive display market share, particularly in Mini-LED applications for instrument clusters and center consoles; (2) Developing cost-effective Mini-LED solutions to drive market adoption; (3) Advancing Micro-LED direct display technology; (4) Developing anti-peeping light guide plates and other specialized optical products; (5) Enhancing automation and intelligent manufacturing capabilities; (6) Expanding product lines across different display technologies (LCD, Mini-LED, Micro-LED) to serve diverse market segments.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of backlight display modules and related components to LCD panel manufacturers and system integrators. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered and accepted by customers based on order-based sales model. The company also generates minor revenue from rental of fixed assets, sale of scrap materials, and other ancillary business activities. Main revenue comes from product sales of backlight modules (64.43% of revenue) and backlight module components (26.88% of revenue).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic backlight display module manufacturer with comprehensive technical capabilities. Major competitors include international suppliers from Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea, as well as other domestic manufacturers. The company differentiates through: (1) Integrated design and manufacturing capabilities across optical, structural, and precision components; (2) Strong customer relationships with major panel manufacturers; (3) Continuous innovation in Mini-LED and emerging display technologies; (4) Significant scale advantages in notebook and tablet segments; (5) Expanding presence in high-growth automotive display market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2023, the company had total assets of 4.664 billion yuan and net assets attributable to parent company shareholders of 1.331 billion yuan. 2023 revenue was 2.163 billion yuan (down 2% from 2022's 2.207 billion yuan), with net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 52.95 million yuan (up 197.41% from 2022's loss of 54.35 million yuan). The company has shown recovery from 2022 losses, with improving profitability. Operating cash flow improved significantly to 164.02 million yuan in 2023 from 47.46 million yuan in 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) One-stop comprehensive solution provider offering integrated design and manufacturing of backlight modules and components; (2) Advanced optical design and light guide plate technology enabling high brightness, uniform illumination, and thin-profile designs; (3) Precision manufacturing capabilities ensuring high quality and reliability; (4) Continuous innovation in emerging technologies (Mini-LED, Micro-LED) addressing market demands for higher performance; (5) Strong customer relationships and supply chain integration with major panel manufacturers; (6) Expanding automotive display solutions addressing growing demand for advanced in-vehicle displays; (7) Cost-effective solutions balancing performance and affordability across different market segments.
